summary: Dicot Pharma AB engages in the development of pharmaceutical products in Sweden. It develops LIB-01 that is in Phase 2a clinical trial for the treatment of erectile dysfunction and under medical discovery for treating premature ejaculation. The company was formerly known as Dicot AB (publ) and changed its name to Dicot Pharma AB in May 2024. Dicot Pharma AB was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Uppsala, Sweden.
